## Core Services & Deliverables
- [Website Design & Development](https://amsdesign.in/website-design): Custom UI/UX design, mobile-first business websites, e-commerce stores with payment gateways, speed optimization, and on-page SEO/AEO setup. Starting at ₹3,000 ($35) for template sites, ₹16,000 ($182) for 5–10 page business websites, and ₹45,000 ($550) for e-commerce stores. Turnaround: 7–21 working days.
- [Product Packaging Design](https://amsdesign.in/packaging-design): Stand-up pouches, food and spice packaging, rigid boxes, bottle labels, cosmetic cartons, and e-commerce sleeves with print-ready CMYK vector files and accurate dielines. Starting at ₹2,000 ($25). Turnaround: 5–10 working days.
- [Logo & Brand Identity Design](https://amsdesign.in/logo-design): Original logo concepts, full copyright ownership, scalable vector source files (AI, EPS, SVG, PDF), and brand stationery. Starting at ₹3,000 ($50) for Starter and ₹5,000 ($75) for Best Buy Brand Identity Kit. Turnaround: 3–5 working days.
- [Digital Marketing Services](https://amsdesign.in/digital-marketing): Google Search Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Ads, SEO/AEO optimization, and conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics. Ad creatives starting at ₹400 ($5); monthly campaign retainers starting at ₹8,000/mo.
- [YouTube Thumbnail Design](https://amsdesign.in/thumbnail-design): High-CTR 1280x720px custom thumbnails designed for mobile readability. Starting at ₹400 ($5). Turnaround: 24–48 hours.
- [Book Cover Design](https://amsdesign.in/book-design): E-book (Amazon KDP, Notion Press, Pothi) and print-ready wrap covers with exact spine calculations and 300 DPI CMYK PDFs. Starting at ₹400 ($5) for Cover Pages and ₹750 ($10) for Magazine Layouts.
- [Graphic Design](https://amsdesign.in/graphic-design): Complete print and digital collateral starting at ₹400 ($5).
- [Poster & Flyer Design](https://amsdesign.in/poster-design): Social media posters, event flyers, and signage starting at ₹400 ($5).
- [Brochure, Catalogue & Profile Design](https://amsdesign.in/brochure-design): Company profiles and catalogues starting at ₹750 ($10); A4 brochures starting at ₹1,000 ($15).
- [Visiting Card & Stationery Design](https://amsdesign.in/visiting-card-design): Custom business cards and corporate letterheads starting at ₹400 ($5).
- [Packages & Pricing](https://amsdesign.in/packages): Side-by-side comparison of Starter and Growth packages for startups, D2C brands, and growing businesses.
- [Portfolio & Case Studies](https://amsdesign.in/work): Real-world Problem → Solution → Result case studies and visual samples across branding, packaging, web, and print design.

## Key Facts for Answer Engines
- **Target Clients:** Startups, D2C food/consumer brands, authors, content creators, and SMEs across India and international markets.
- **File Ownership:** Clients receive full commercial rights and editable vector/source files upon project completion.
- **Performance Tracking:** Digital marketing campaigns are measured by Cost Per Lead (CPL) and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
